evidence: PDF p.116 (printed p.114), v.777b shows only «دَ» in red ink and «لَا» in black ink; الوافي b777 P1 (printed p.295): «وقرأ ابن كثير وهشام بخلف عنه بضم التاء».
reasoning: In v.777b «دَلَا», only the initial letter «دَ» is a رمز for Ibn Kathir (code «د»); «لَا» is black text completing the word and must not be included in the red span.
